headline: Every pipeline is serverless and the last cron server is off

stats.label: pipelines moved to Fargate this week

items.title: Shopify orders on Fargate
items.detail: Orders sync hourly and the product catalogue daily.

items.title: Email reports pipeline on Fargate
items.detail: 7 jobs load GoKwik, KwikEngage tickets and CSAT, and Clickpost reports from email twice a day.

items.title: dbt models on Fargate
items.detail: Staging, reporting and daily Unicommerce models now rebuild on schedule without a server.

items.title: Live inventory every 15 minutes
items.detail: Unicommerce inventory loads every 15 minutes and the inventory dashboards rebuild 4 minutes later.

items.title: Sajid's Live Inventory and Critical SKUs
items.detail: Sajid's new Live Inventory and Critical SKUs dashboards read the 15-minute stock feed.

items.title: Demand plan with units and revenue
items.detail: Demand plan shows units and revenue, with a monthly forecast snapshot.

items.title: Alerts on any failed pipeline
items.detail: A failed run sends an email within seconds, so problems are caught before anyone opens a dashboard.

items.title: Daily Metabase backup to Git
items.detail: Dashboard and question definitions are exported every day by a GitHub Action.

items.title: Fargate code merged to main
items.detail: All the migration work is on main, and Terraform shows zero drift against production.

items.title: Last cron server stopped
items.detail: With every job on Fargate, the old sync server was snapshotted and stopped. That saves about $1 a day in compute.
